# Windows Template Library

Vendored headers from **WTL 10.01 Release**, published 2026-03-01.

- Upstream: https://sourceforge.net/projects/wtl/
- Archive: https://sourceforge.net/projects/wtl/files/WTL%2010/WTL%2010.01%20Release/WTL10_01_Release.zip/download
- Archive SHA-1: `7d871b5947f7bb2139f719b59eb1fbbac2c59bf1`
- License: Microsoft Public License, included in `MS-PL.txt`.

`Include/` and the license are extracted unchanged from the release archive.
Building requires Visual Studio's C++ ATL component and does not download WTL.
